description: Check whether two images (or embeddings) show the same person. Uses the best face on each side. Returns face_found, similarity (0-1, null when a side has no face), match and the threshold used. Each side is a public URL, a CDN key or a 512-number embedding. Costs 93 credits per image processed: 186 for two images, 93 for one image and one embedding, 93 for two embeddings.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry that reuses the key is never charged twice: if the first call finished, the retry gets 409 duplicate_request_already_processed; if it is still running, 409 duplicate_request_in_flight. Use a new key for each different request.

source_gcs_key.description: CDN key of the first image.

source_url.description: Public URL of the first image.

target_gcs_key.description: CDN key of the second image.

target_url.description: Public URL of the second image.

name: compare_faces
title: Compare two faces
